title: Changelog:
description:
Changelog:
  * Replace code derived from GNU coreutils (LP: #2173645):
    - d/p/chcon-report-verbose-write-failures: Report verbose write failures
      instead of panicking (prerequisite).
    - d/p/chcon-rewrite-traversal-and-relabeling: Rewrite the chcon traversal
      and relabeling.
    - d/p/dircolors-restore-fsf-copyright-notice: Restore the FSF copyright
      notice of the color database.
  * Restore integration test execution during package build (LP: #2174403):
    - d/rules: Pass --no-fail-fast to cargo test so a failing test binary
      does not prevent the remaining test binaries from running.
    - d/p/require-utility-to-be-invoked-at-matching-path.patch: Adapt
      binary_name_execfn_fallback to use a hard link named true instead of a
      memfd, preserving coverage with the executable-name check. Create the
      temporary directory on the binary's filesystem to avoid cross-device
      errors and copy/exec races during parallel tests.

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~varranvar/+archive/ubuntu/uutils3
